result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the middle card ('Smash Bros Burgers') is vertically misaligned and shifted downward compared to the adjacent cards ('Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccola').
issues.suggestion: Remove any unintended top margin or padding on the middle card so that all cards in the horizontal list align along their top edges.
